flavor_text: A soft green shape quivers beside the forest road, waiting in the grass.
Heavy footsteps circle just beyond the brush, never drawing close enough to reveal their source.
A goblin scout darts between the roots, and the glade falls suddenly quiet.
A bowstring hums once above the trail, and fletched arrows mark the safest path through the trees.
At the forest center, the oldest roots twist around a dark crown.
A skeleton guard rattles to life in the dungeon's first stone corridor.
A silent figure slips through the torchlight, leaving warning marks scratched into the stone where the corridor grows dangerous.
A battered chest sits in the torchlight, and its lid blinks.
A covered cart waits where the dungeon paths cross.
The dungeon doors groan open as the Iron Bear emerges from the buried forge.
A pale light slips between the ruined shelves and bars the way.
Pages turn atop a ruined lectern as watchful eyes gleam from the rafters.
Frost gathers across the old stone as an elemental rises.
A lantern-lit merchant has made camp among the fallen stacks.
The archive doors freeze shut as the Frostwarden descends.
